device.description: 8-bit 189 kSPS I2C SAR ADC with out-of-range alert
device.note: adc081c021.pdf (SNAS447C) p.3 connection diagrams (Figures 1 and 3), p.4 pin descriptions and package pinouts table, p.5 operating ratings, p.6 I2C input levels, p.8 conversion time, p.15-16 converter operation and transfer function, p.17-22 registers, p.22-24 serial interface and slave addresses (Table 2)

pages: p.3 connection diagrams (Figures 1 and 3), p.4 pin descriptions and package pinouts table, p.5 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.8 (conversion time 1 us), p.15 (conversion at each result read / automatic mode), p.16 (straight binary), p.17-22 (registers), p.22-23 (read/write sequences), p.24 (Table 2 slave addresses)
notModeled: VSSOP-8 address straps ADDR0/ADDR1 (tri-level: GND, floating, VA; 9 addresses 0x50-0x5A, Table 2): the pins exist only in the DGK pinout, so the bus uses the SOT-6 fixed address 0x54 (1010100) for both packages (= DGK with ADDR1 = GND, ADDR0 floating)
ALERT output (open drain, polarity CONFIG.POLARITY, enable CONFIG.ALERT_PIN_EN): never asserted
analog input (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
the CONVERSION register holds the 8-bit code in bits 11:4 (left-justified in a 12-bit field); the schema does not say where a result register's code goes (identical here: the code is 0)
automatic conversion mode (CONFIG.CYCLE_TIME != 0: conversions every Tconvert x 32..2048) - the schema's mode field takes one continuous value; CYCLE_TIME is stored only
alert function: VHIGH/VLOW/VHYST comparison, ALERT_STATUS flags (write-1-to-clear), the CONVERSION.ALERT_FLAG bit, VMIN/VMAX tracking in automatic mode
conversion starts at the ACK of the address byte of a read (about 400 ns acquisition + conversion, 1 us typ); the model starts the next conversion after each read of the result
reserved bits of the 16-bit limit registers read 0 but VHIGH/VMIN reset to 0FFFh per the datasheet (bits 3:0 set); they are marked read-only
I2C Hs-mode master code entry, quiet interface mode, automatic power-down between conversions
power-on reset brown-out behaviour (registers lost below 2.4 V)
variants: ADC081C027 shares the datasheet (SOT-6 with an ADDR0 pin instead of ALERT): own spec file. ADC101C021/ADC121C021 are the 10/12-bit pin-compatible parts (other datasheets)
